about: The plans' and offers' sources the bridge reads itself (proactive agents, branch 7 `plans-sources`: passation-pro briefs/design-agents-proactifs.md §3.2 n° 4 and 5, §3.4 « Réponses dues » and « L'agenda », §3.5, §3.7, §6 row 7, §7.3; Alex 22/11: Q10 A, Q11 A, replies due turned on mailbox by mailbox, the trip offered at the next exchange, « vers 8 h », 90 days for what the bridge sets up on its own, no quiet hours of ours). Three sources: (1) the calendars an agent reads (the phone's copy, Google Calendar, a mailbox's CalDAV calendars): an appointment in 1 to 7 days, with a place, with no plan; (2) the Carnet's trips: a trip starting within 7 days, with no plan; (3) the replies due of a mailbox the person turned on: an e-mail waiting more than a day for a reply. Nothing costs while nothing is found: no model call, a once-a-day look. Kept in `<data>/plans-sources.json` (0600) by bridge-rs/src/plans/sources.rs (`plans::sources`). Read by bridge/tests_blackbox/test_plans_sources.py and test_reply_due.py, plans/sources/tests.rs, tests/tools-knowledge_google_calendar.rs and tools-knowledge_caldav.rs (the bridge), and by the apps' OfferCard (branches plans-ios, plans-android). Additions only: an app 1.0 draws every card below as its generic Yes / No card. Outlook (branch `outlook`) is not a source here.

who.may: An agent the sources are read for: it proposes (contracts/proactive: « Initiative » not off; never an agent other people talk to: the family's agent, a project agent, an agent shared with relatives), its model is not outside (`outside_model::place` once branch shared-memory is in: an agent on a model outside our European providers and the person's own never has their calendar or e-mails read to propose; until then the hook `plans::sources::outside` answers no), and its « Routines » are on for the calendar and the trips (their plans are routines).
who.calendar: The agent that reads a calendar (the phone's copy shared with it to read, Google Calendar given to it, a mailbox of its with CalDAV); several: the one the person writes to most (the last 14 days, feature_tips.rs `talks`), then by name.
who.trip: The agent of category « daily » (« Quotidien ») with the Carnet; else the calendar's agent when it has the Carnet; else the one with the Carnet the person writes to most.
who.replies: The agent of the mailbox (mailbox given to it) the person writes to most; its watch, its cards and its drafts are that agent's.

calendar.look: Once a day « vers 8 h » (`[plans_sources] morning`, the person's clock; a bridge down then looks at its first tick of the day after), the next 7 days of every calendar the agent reads: an event is kept when it starts in 1 to 7 days (its day after today's), is not all-day, does not repeat, has a place (`location`), and no plan of the place follows it (its `event`) or is about it (an appointment plan of the same title with a moment within the day before it). At most 3 per agent, the soonest first.
calendar.hint: The next time the person writes to that agent (any of their own conversations with it, never a routine's, a pair's or the family's common one), the bridge adds ONE hidden line to their message (live_brief.rs `message_notes`, like the Carnet's news): what is coming, between the calendars' markers (calendar.rs `UNTRUSTED`), and that it may propose a plan for it (plan_propose with its `event`) after answering what they asked. No turn of its own. Told once.
calendar.card: No exchange with that agent by the day before (J−1, its morning look) and its person's home is known (a « Coordonnées » entry labelled as home: plans.rs `home_of`) and the streets on: the bridge places ONE offer card itself, no model (`bip-offer-`, kind `appointment`): texts.<lang>.calendar_offer. The caps of the cards nobody asked for apply (plans and offers together: one waiting per agent, 2 a day per agent, 4 for the place); held: no card (the hint stays told or not). Never twice for one event.
calendar.yes: « Oui »: the bridge sets up the plan itself, no model, no second card (this card was its yes): a reminder the day before at 19:00 when still to come (texts.<lang>.calendar_reminder, `what` texts.<lang>.calendar_reminder_what), and when to leave (plans.rs' route moment: the place and the home to the geocoder, then the router, ONLY now, as at « Prévoir »; on foot when 30 minutes or less, else by transit), urgent; the plan follows its event (moved: the moments move, one line; cancelled: the plan goes, one line: contracts/plans `texts.moved` / `cancelled`). The way not found: no moment to leave, plans.rs' line `route_failed`.
calendar.follow: A plan's `event` may now be `{source: phone | google | caldav, id}` (plan_propose; the ids as calendar_list gives them: google `google:<calendar>:<event>`, caldav `mail:<mailbox>:<href>`). The phone's: compared with each copy the phone sends (as before). Google's and CalDAV's: the `calendar_event` watch of the bridge, no program written by the model, reads the event again every hour (`[plans_sources] follow_seconds`): moved, cancelled (gone from its calendar while that calendar answered), or the same; a calendar that could not be read changes nothing. A repeating event is never followed.

trip.look: At the same morning look: the Carnet's trips (notebook/trip.rs `upcoming`) starting in 1 to 7 days, not cancelled (`cancelled`), with no plan of kind trip of the place whose moments fall within its dates (a day before its start to its end).
trip.hint: As the calendar's: the next exchange with the trip's agent, one hidden line (its city, its dates, its page in the Carnet), told once.
trip.card: No exchange by two days before its start (J−2): ONE offer card (`bip-offer-`, kind `trip`): texts.<lang>.trip_offer; under « i » texts.<lang>.trip_prompt (what the agent will be asked, exactly).
trip.yes: « Oui »: ONE turn of the agent in its main conversation with the hidden note of an offer's « Oui » (plans/offers.rs `yes_note`): look at the trip in the Carnet and propose ONE plan with plan_propose (its card asks « Prévoir »: nothing runs before). That plan is taken as asked by the person (the daily caps don't hold it) within 15 minutes of the « Oui ».

replies.consent: Off for every mailbox (Alex: « à allumer par boîte »). The first time, once per mailbox, at the morning look: ONE card (`bip-offer-`, kind `reply_watch`, about the mailbox's address): texts.<lang>.consent, under « i » texts.<lang>.consent_under_i. Expired without an answer: asked once more 14 days later, never a third time. « Non merci »: never asked again for that mailbox. The caps of the cards nobody asked for apply.
replies.on: « Oui » (or `PUT /v1/agents/{agent}/replies {account, on: true}`): a trigger of that mailbox made by the bridge (`by: replies`, kind `mail`, no filter, on at once, `ends` 90 days later: task_frame.rs' default end), listed in « Ce que tes agents font tout seuls » as a trigger (paused, deleted with the trigger's routes, as an app 1.0 does), its name texts.<lang>.watch_name. The mailbox watched by IMAP IDLE from its newest message: nothing older is ever read.
replies.headers: Each new message: its headers only (`BODY.PEEK[HEADER.FIELDS (FROM SUBJECT DATE MESSAGE-ID LIST-ID LIST-UNSUBSCRIBE PRECEDENCE AUTO-SUBMITTED X-AUTO-RESPONSE-SUPPRESS)]`), never its text: kept when it is not a mass mailing (`List-Unsubscribe`, `List-Id`, `Precedence` bulk/list/junk, `Auto-Submitted` other than no, `X-Auto-Response-Suppress`), nor from a robot (noreply, notification, newsletter, mailer-daemon…), nor from the mailbox's own address. Kept: {account, uid, message_id, from, subject, date, seen}. No model.
replies.due: « vers 18 h » (`[plans_sources] evening`), once a day per mailbox: an e-mail is due when seen more than 24 h ago (`due_hours`) and no message of the Sent folder (its special-use flag \Sent, else its usual names) cites it (`UID SEARCH HEADER In-Reply-To <id>`, then `References`), it is not flagged \Answered, and it is still in the inbox (archived or deleted: done). A Sent folder that can't be read: nothing is due that evening.
replies.card: Due e-mails not yet shown on a card: ONE offer card (`bip-offer-`, kind `draft`, source `replies`) built by the bridge from the headers only, no model: the due e-mails, at most 8, the longest waiting first (`bip_offer.items: [{from, subject, since}]`, `bip_offer.top` texts.<lang>.replies_top or replies_top_one), the question texts.<lang>.replies_question, under « i » one line per e-mail (texts.<lang>.replies_line) then texts.<lang>.replies_under_i. The caps of the cards nobody asked for apply; held: the next evening.
replies.yes: « Oui »: ONE turn of the agent (its main conversation, counted in the credit as a request) that reads these e-mails only and writes their drafts: the hidden note lists their ids (`<mailbox>|INBOX|<uid>`) and headers between the e-mails' markers (mailbox.rs `UNTRUSTED`); in that turn `mail_read` opens those ids only, `mail_draft` answers those only (`reply_to_id`), `mail_search` and `mail_attachment` are refused; nothing is ever sent (there is no tool to). The e-mails are marked drafted.
replies.no: « Non merci »: those e-mails are not shown again. Expired: shown again with the next new one.
replies.kept: Headers only. An e-mail's headers go 14 days after it was answered (a reply in Sent, \Answered), drafted (« Oui ») or declined (« Non merci »); any 30 days after it was seen; all of a mailbox's at once when its watch stops (paused, deleted, ended, the mailbox no longer the agent's).
replies.end: Its end (90 days): the trigger goes, one Boîte line without a notification (task_frame.rs `ended_line`, validated), and the consent card may come again (once).

routes.about: The agent's mailboxes and their replies-due watch (for the apps 1.1's switch, mailbox by mailbox). 404 unknown agent.

errors.404: unknown agent, or a mailbox not given to it
errors.409: the agent doesn't propose (« Initiative » off, other people talk to it) or its model is outside

routes.about: The person's own switch: on as the consent card's « Oui »; off: the watch and every header kept for that mailbox go.

offer_kinds.about: The bridge's own offer cards are `bip-offer-` cards (contracts/offers: answered `once` / `deny`, never « Toujours », critical: approval_level.rs `offer`, never auto-approved) with kinds the agent itself can never offer (its offer_act lists only the seven of contracts/offers) and `bip_offer.source`.

appointment.label: texts.<lang>.calendar_offer
appointment.bip_detail: texts.<lang>.calendar_detail_reminder (when the day before at 19:00 is still to come) + texts.<lang>.calendar_detail_route + texts.<lang>.calendar_detail_follow
appointment.expires: 24 h, or two hours before the event

draft.label: texts.<lang>.replies_question
draft.bip_summary: texts.<lang>.replies_top (or replies_top_one) + « . » + the question: an app 1.0's whole card

offer_kinds.learning: Counted as the agent's offers are (two « Non merci » in a row, a low share of yes: quiet 30 days), by source and kind (`calendar:appointment`, `trip:trip`, `replies:reply_watch`, `replies:draft`): never one of the agent's own kinds.

app_1_0.cards: Each card above as its generic card: bip_summary, bip_detail under « i », « Oui » / « Non » (`once` / `deny`). A replies card's bip_summary says how many e-mails wait and the question; its e-mails are under « i ».
app_1_0.autonomous: The replies-due watch is a `trigger` item (kind mail): its pause and delete go through the trigger routes an app 1.0 already calls; `when.replies` and `detail.replies` ({account, mailbox}) are new keys it ignores.
app_1_0.plans: The plan the bridge sets up at an appointment's « Oui » is routines in « Ce que tes agents font tout seuls », as any plan's.

rules.apostrophes: The bridge writes the apps' typographic apostrophe (’).
rules.lang: The agent's language (names.rs `agent_language`); another than these four: English.
rules.validated: calendar_offer, trip_offer, consent, replies_top, replies_line, replies_question, replies_under_i, replies_notification: §7.3, validated by Alex on 22/11.
rules.new: Everything else here: new, for Alex's OK (passation-pro briefs/status-plans-sources.md, « Textes à valider »).
rules.day: {day}: the short day and its date (« jeu. 26 », « Thu 26 », « Do. 26. », « jue. 26 »); {time}: HH:MM on the person's clock; {dates}: « 25–28 nov. », « 30 nov.–2 déc. » (fr), « Nov 25–28 » (en), « 25.–28. Nov. » (de), « 25–28 nov. » (es); {since}: texts.<lang>.since_one / since_many.

fr.calendar_offer: {title} {day} à {time} · Je prépare le trajet et un rappel ?
fr.consent: Je te dis quand un e-mail attend ta réponse depuis plus d’un jour, dans {mailbox} ? Je ne lis que l’expéditeur et l’objet.
fr.replies_under_i: Les brouillons vont dans tes Brouillons ; rien n’est envoyé.
fr.consent_under_i: Le soir, s’il y en a, une carte te les montre, et je prépare les brouillons si tu veux. Tu l’arrêtes dans « Ce que tes agents font tout seuls ».
fr.watch_prompt: Le soir, je te dis quels e-mails attendent ta réponse depuis plus d’un jour (l’expéditeur et l’objet seulement).
fr.calendar_detail_route: Le jour même, l’heure de partir pour {place}, calculée à ton « Oui » depuis chez toi.
fr.trip_prompt: Je regarde ton voyage dans le Carnet et je te propose un plan : les bons rappels au bon moment. Rien n’est réservé.

en.calendar_offer: {title} {day} at {time} · Shall I prepare the route and a reminder?
en.trip_offer: {city}, {dates} · Shall I get your trip ready?
en.consent: Shall I tell you when an e-mail in {mailbox} has waited over a day for your reply? I only read the sender and subject.
en.replies_top: {agent} · {n} e-mails are waiting for your reply
en.replies_under_i: The drafts go to your Drafts folder; nothing is sent.
en.replies_notification: {n} e-mails are waiting for your reply
en.replies_top_one: {agent} · 1 e-mail is waiting for your reply
en.replies_notification_one: 1 e-mail is waiting for your reply
en.consent_under_i: In the evening, if there are any, a card shows them, and I draft the replies if you want. You stop it in “What your agents do on their own”.
en.watch_prompt: In the evening, I tell you which e-mails have waited over a day for your reply (the sender and subject only).
en.calendar_detail_route: On the day, when to leave for {place}, worked out at your “Yes” from your home.
en.calendar_detail_follow: If it moves, the reminders follow.
en.trip_prompt: I look at your trip in the Notebook and suggest a plan: the right reminders at the right time. Nothing is booked.

de.calendar_offer: {title} {day} um {time} · Soll ich den Weg und eine Erinnerung vorbereiten?
de.consent: Soll ich dir sagen, wenn eine E-Mail in {mailbox} seit über einem Tag auf deine Antwort wartet? Ich lese nur Absender und Betreff.
de.replies_under_i: Die Entwürfe landen in deinem Entwürfe-Ordner; nichts wird gesendet.
de.consent_under_i: Am Abend zeigt dir eine Karte sie, falls es welche gibt, und ich entwerfe die Antworten, wenn du willst. Du stoppst das unter „Was deine Agenten von selbst tun“.
de.watch_prompt: Am Abend sage ich dir, welche E-Mails seit über einem Tag auf deine Antwort warten (nur Absender und Betreff).
de.calendar_detail_route: Am Tag selbst, wann du nach {place} aufbrechen solltest, berechnet bei deinem „Ja“ ab deinem Zuhause.
de.calendar_detail_follow: Verschiebt er sich, ziehen die Erinnerungen mit.
de.trip_prompt: Ich sehe mir deine Reise im Notizbuch an und schlage dir einen Plan vor: die richtigen Erinnerungen zur richtigen Zeit. Nichts wird gebucht.

es.calendar_offer: {title} el {day} a las {time} · ¿Preparo el trayecto y un recordatorio?
es.consent: ¿Te aviso cuando un correo de {mailbox} lleve más de un día esperando tu respuesta? Solo leo el remitente y el asunto.
es.replies_under_i: Los borradores van a tu carpeta de Borradores; no se envía nada.
es.consent_under_i: Por la tarde, si hay alguno, una tarjeta te los muestra, y preparo los borradores si quieres. Lo detienes en «Lo que tus agentes hacen solos».
es.watch_prompt: Por la tarde, te digo qué correos llevan más de un día esperando tu respuesta (solo el remitente y el asunto).
es.calendar_detail_route: El mismo día, cuándo salir hacia {place}, calculado con tu «Sí» desde tu casa.
es.calendar_detail_follow: Si cambia, los recordatorios se ajustan.
es.trip_prompt: Miro tu viaje en el Cuaderno y te propongo un plan: los recordatorios justos en el momento justo. No se reserva nada.
